definitions.gloss: mental aspect; psychological side; emotional dimension
definitions.explanation: The mental or psychological dimension of a person, activity, or situation, as opposed to the physical or technical aspects. Frequently used when discussing what makes someone strong, healthy, or successful beyond physical ability.

examples.japanese: {精神面|せいしんめん}を{鍛|きた}える。
スポーツでは{精神面|せいしんめん}の{強|つよ}さが{勝敗|しょうはい}を{左右|さゆう}する。
examples.english: In sports, mental strength can determine victory or defeat.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}からの{回復|かいふく}には{体力|たいりょく}だけでなく、{精神面|せいしんめん}でのサポートも{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Recovery from illness requires not only physical strength but also psychological support.

notes:
USAGE:
{精神面|せいしんめん} is a compound of {精神|せいしん} (mind, spirit) and {面|めん} (aspect, side). It is commonly used to distinguish the psychological dimension from physical or technical aspects, particularly in sports, health, and education contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精神面|せいしんめん}を{鍛|きた}える (to train mentally)
- {精神面|せいしんめん}の{強|つよ}さ (mental strength)
- {精神面|せいしんめん}でのサポート (psychological support)
- {精神面|せいしんめん}での{成長|せいちょう} (mental/emotional growth)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精神面|せいしんめん}: mental aspect (used as a framework for discussion)
- {精神的|せいしんてき}: mental, psychological (adjectival, modifies nouns directly)
- {肉体面|にくたいめん}: physical aspect (the counterpart to {精神面|せいしんめん})
- メンタル: mental (loanword, casual)
